thesis: The podcast argues that the Silicon Valley Bank collapse was a unique convergence of an asset-liability mismatch and the internet's ability to accelerate fund transfers, creating a systemic crisis that regulators failed to prevent by not opening the discount window early enough. It further posits that the United States' fragmented banking system, which supports small businesses and startups, remains vulnerable to future runs unless a new infrastructure allows hundreds of community banks to work together as co-owners.
